description: Validate and apply a Brand Pack to a surface without inventing identity or constraining composition to a fixed template.

pre_conditions.check: The client-owned folder named brand is resolved and reports ready
Brand slug is explicit or resolved by unambiguous single-pack detection

steps.name: Resolve brand folder and pack
steps.description: Resolve the configured or project-local folder named brand. If missing or stale, ask for its absolute path and run config set. Dynamically discover sibling packs, select exactly one slug, and run status.

steps.name: Validate integrity
steps.description: Run validate and stop on any immutable pack or client rules divergence.

steps.name: Load sources
steps.description: Read source, tokens, guidelines, manifest, and the optional brand.rules.json in the required order.

steps.name: Resolve surface context
steps.description: Run context for the requested surface and map pack rules, active client rules, assets, iconography, typography, colors, layout, and voice. Build a spacing relationship map for page or canvas margins, section gaps, component insets, and internal stack gaps from declared layout.spacing tokens.

steps.name: Structure content
steps.description: For a document or presentation, preserve content and global order, group by meaning, and map actions, capabilities, states, and notes to official icons when semantically appropriate. For an HTML document, choose continuous flow or page canvas and derive final geometry when paginated.

steps.name: Implement
steps.description: Create the deliverable with declared pack values, the spacing relationship map, and applicable client rules. Reuse official iconography before decorative markers and use cards, dividers, or callouts only for a clear editorial function. Size text-bearing containers from content by default; never conceal authored content to satisfy a fixed frame. For page canvas, share geometry between the sheet and @page and keep workspace, gaps, and shadows screen-only.

steps.name: Validate output
steps.description: Re-run validate, project checks, and visual review at relevant breakpoints and export formats after final fonts load. Inspect text and child bounds, scroll dimensions, preserved bottom and trailing-edge insets, icon use, authorized extensions, emphasis treatments, and desktop/mobile/print page-canvas parity when applicable.

post_conditions.check: Brand Pack and client rules remain valid
Output follows tokens, assets, pack rules, surface rules, and applicable client rules
Editorial surfaces contain no orphaned headings, clipping, overflow, semantically poor pagination, or functionless decorative callouts
Official iconography was inventoried and every authorized local extension remains outside the Brand Pack
Paginated HTML derives its canvas from the final format, removes preview chrome in print, and remains readable on mobile
Text-bearing containers preserve complete content and their mapped spacing in every rendered target without hidden overflow or edge collisions
